title: To Build a Fire
focus: human limits in an indifferent nature

teacherSummary.text: A newcomer to the Yukon sets out alone with a wolf-dog at seventy-five below zero, ignoring an old-timer's warning never to travel alone in such cold. He breaks through ice and wets his feet, builds a fire under a snow-laden spruce, and the snow falls and puts it out. His hands freeze; he fails to light another, thinks of killing the dog for warmth, runs in panic, and freezes to death. The dog trots off toward camp.
